messages:
maria: Heads-up — canary run for raven-lite int8 is spiking parse failures. Suspected root: trailing EOS marker getting dropped in streaming path, then retry loop causes duplicate funcalls. Seen ~0.8% fail -> retry -> duplicate tool invocations in staging

lukas: ugh. do we have traces linking the failure to the streaming boundary?

maria: yes, attached a small trace snippet from today: 
```
[stream] chunk1: '{\"action\": \"call\", "name": "get_user"'
[stream] chunk2: ', "args": {"id": 123}}
[stream] chunk3: '<EOS>' (dropped)
invoke: parser -> error: unexpected EOF
retry: resend request -> model returns full payload with funcall -> duplicate effects
```

ashley: Can we gate retries on schema-success? i.e. only retry if parser fails AND we didn't already emit a funcall token to the downstream system. Might be tricky because the retry happens earlier in the runtime.

maria: that's the idea. Two orthogonal mitigations proposed: 1) sentinelized wrapper in the streaming layer that injects a soft-final marker sequence into the tail (non-model-visible token but present in stream boundary metadata) 2) change retry-runbook to check a per-request 'funcall-ack' bit before issuing a retry

lukas: for (1) are we planning to inject via transport metadata or actually append a token to the token stream? appending could affect logits.

maria: transport metadata preferred. we already have chunk-level metadata for bounce-detection. Add a 'final_chunk_hash' boolean so parser knows a chunk was intended terminal. If the final chunk arrives but the explicit EOS is missing, treat as candidate terminal and attempt local merge heuristics rather than triggering a retry immediately.

eval-bot: actionable test plan: 
- create canary variant with 5k requests, intentionally strip EOS in 0.5% of traces
- run with current retry policy (baseline) and with 'deferred-retry' policy that waits 200ms for additional chunks before retrying
- measure duplicate-toolcall-rate and user-visible failures

maria: +1. also add instrumentation for: 'retry_reason', 'saw_funcall_before_retry', 'chunk_gap_ms'

ashley: quick implementation sketch for deferred-retry: in runtime/request_handler.go add a short-timer when parser returns EOF error for streaming requests; if timer fires without new chunk, proceed with retry. If new chunk arrives within timer, attempt join-and-parse and avoid retry. pseudocode: 
```
if streaming && parse_error == EOF {
  start_timer(200ms)
  wait_for_chunk_or_timer()
  if new_chunk { merge_and_parse() } else { trigger_retry() }
}
```

lukas: 200ms seems arbitrary. We should derive from observed chunk_gap_ms p50/p95. Can we quick-query the telemetry?

infra-bot: telemetry: chunk_gap_ms p50=18ms p95=120ms over last 72h for raven-lite-canary.

lukas: ok p95=120ms so 200ms is conservative but safe. We'll A/B down later.

maria: another edge: if a funcall begins streaming (we see the name field) then we MUST not retry even if final marker missing, because duplicate side-effects are dangerous. So add 'funcall-seen' sticky flag per-request.

ashley: where do we set the flag? parser emits 'funcall_candidate' when it parses a partial object with a top-level action==call. runtime should propagate that into request state before downstream commit.

maria: yes. and change retry logic to treat requests with funcall_candidate=true as non-retriable on parse EOF — instead surface a structured error to the caller and let higher-level orchestration decide (e.g., idempotency rules).

eval-bot: acceptance criteria for rollout: 
- canary-deferred reduces duplicate-toolcall-rate by >85% vs baseline in synthetic EOF-drop test
- end-user parse-failure rate does not increase by >0.05%
- telemetry flags added and surfaced in console per-request

maria: I'll open an RFC with design + signal matrix. Lukas / Ashley can you own the canary implementation + dashboard widgets?

lukas: I can own the runtime change + unit tests. Will PR today and target canary tomorrow.

ashley: I'll own parser flagging and eval harness change. I'll also add a fuzzed streaming test that simulates mid-chunk truncation.

infra-bot: deploy-bot: canary cluster provisioned: raven-lite-int8-canary-3, capacity 200rps.

maria: thanks. one more note: we should add a safefail mode in Dedicated where retry is disabled by default for any request marked non-idempotent. That'll be a follow-on enterprise policy.

lukas: noted. will add a config toggle (retry_policy.non_idempotent=false)

maria: cool — next steps: RFC + two PRs (runtime, parser) + canary smoke job. I'll tag reviewers. :thumbsup:
